summary: Proposal to systematically use package.json exports to define clean, explicit entry points for cross-package imports in the TypeScript SDK, replacing the current pattern of directly importing from /lib/ directories.
userImpact: Improves developer experience by providing clear, stable public API entry points and makes the SDK maintainable through proper module boundaries.
proposedFix: Use the exports field in package.json to define subpath exports (e.g., ./workflow) and enforce imports through these declared exports rather than direct /lib/ paths.
keyQuote: No more `/lib/` imports: all cross-package imports should go through declared exports.
